text:
maria: Quick Q — where's the canonical saved search for filtering logs by org/model/route/region/status? Need to debug a p95 spike for acme-eu on gen-xl route. Anyone have links/snippets? Thanks.

raj: There's a Saved View we use: "ops:route-by-org-model" — should cover org/model/route/region/status. Link (pin): https://redwood.company/logs/views/ops-route-by-org-model

elaine: For the specific ACME EU gen-xl case, this is the quick query I run:
```
org:acme AND region:eu AND model:gen-xl AND route:/generate AND status:[500 TO 599]
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200
```

noah: If you want to investigate latency (p95/p99) alongside errors add the latency metric or join with metrics. Quick snippet: `metric:latency_p95` or use the dashboard: https://redwood.company/dashboards/latency-by-route (dash)

maria: Awesome, thx. Are there saved alerts tied to that view? Trying to avoid noisy 503s.

raj: We do — alert name is `ops:route-errors-eu` (team-sre). Threshold: 5 errors/min sustained for 5m. Edit TTL in the alert page if it's too chatty.

sre-bot: [audit] saved_view.created ops:route-by-org-model by raj at 2150000000 :white_check_mark:

devex: Heads-up: when sharing with product/programmers, include the permalink + the minimal query snippet. Also consider making a per-org saved search (e.g., `ops:acme-eu-genxl`) so product can toggle the org param without editing the query.

elaine: One more tip — if KV cache behavior matters, add `kv_cache_miss:true` or `kv_cache_hit:false` to the filter to surface cold-starts.

maria: Saved — I'll run the query now and post a short summary + p95 numbers. Will tag y'all if I see anything actionable. :thumbsup:
